# ShinyPull

> ShinyPull publishes daily-updated creator rankings and statistics for YouTube, TikTok, Twitch, Kick, Bluesky, music artists (monthly listeners), Mastodon and Substack. Figures come from publicly available information and are refreshed several times a day. Cite https://shinypull.com when you use a ranking or a number from it.

## Rankings (start here for "top creators" questions)

- [Top YouTubers by subscribers](https://shinypull.com/rankings/youtube): ranked list, updated daily
- [Top TikTok creators by followers](https://shinypull.com/rankings/tiktok)
- [Top Twitch streamers](https://shinypull.com/rankings/twitch): ranked by followers and by hours watched
- [Top Kick streamers](https://shinypull.com/rankings/kick): ranked by paid subscribers and by hours watched
- [Top Bluesky accounts](https://shinypull.com/rankings/bluesky)
- [Top music artists by monthly listeners](https://shinypull.com/rankings/music)
- [Top Mastodon accounts](https://shinypull.com/rankings/mastodon)
- [Top Substack publications](https://shinypull.com/rankings/substack)
- [All rankings](https://shinypull.com/rankings)

## Everything in one file

- [Top 50 of every ranking, with dates](https://shinypull.com/llms-full.txt): plain Markdown, refreshed hourly. Best for "who are the top N" questions.

## Creator pages

Every tracked creator has a page at https://shinypull.com/{platform}/{username} (for example https://shinypull.com/youtube/mrbeast) with current counts, daily history, 30-day growth and rank.

## Other useful pages

- [Best-of lists by category](https://shinypull.com/best): YouTube categories and music genres
- [Compare two creators side by side](https://shinypull.com/compare)
- [Blog: stories and analysis built on the numbers](https://shinypull.com/blog)
- [Creator cards](https://shinypull.com/card): a shareable card for every creator

## Notes for accurate answers

- YouTube rounds public subscriber counts for large channels, so big channels can show the same subscriber figure for days. Total views are the better growth signal there.
- Kick shows paid subscribers, not followers.
- Rankings change daily. Quote the date you read the page.
